title: Close Encounters contains a visual reference to Project Serpo

tellings.quote: >> And by the way, whether you believe it or not, put that aside, there's a whole kind of visual reference to Project Serpo in there,

plain: A researcher named Bryce Zabel, on Jesse Michels' podcast, says that Steven Spielberg's 1977 film Close Encounters of the Third Kind, which ends at Devils Tower in Wyoming, contains a whole visual reference to Project Serpo, a claimed secret programme in which Americans are said to have travelled to another world. He says it is there whether or not you believe in Serpo, which would suggest the filmmakers knew of the story.
